fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/gate shows the plan the tool prints with -dry-run in a temporary git repo: a change to one internal package lists go test for that package and its reverse dependencies only, then make self-check; a change only under .rhiza/ lists make self-check only; a change to go.mod, or an empty RHIZA_GATE_BASE, lists make test and make self-check; a changed cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/foo.txtar with a leaf acceptance naming TestScripts/bar lists cmd/rhiza with -run 'TestScripts/(bar|foo)$'; grep -n "rhiza.ship.localGate 'make gate'" AGENTS.md finds the line
fields.statement: Rhiza's own repo has a scoped gate, make gate running a Go tool under tools/gate, that from RHIZA_GATE_BASE runs go test -trimpath on the Go packages the branch changes and their reverse dependencies (cmd/rhiza's TestScripts limited to the changed txtar files and those named TestScripts/<name> in the leaf acceptance checks of RHIZA_CHANGE), then make self-check, with cmd/rhiza under the machine-wide test lock, and falls back to make test plus make self-check when the base is empty or go.mod, go.sum, the Makefile, tools/gate or cmd/rhiza/main_test.go changed; AGENTS.md says to set rhiza.ship.localGate to 'make gate'
